title: ANGEL
subtitle: Across the Eras
blurb: Pick a season, a Big Bad, a member of the team, a romance, an LA haunt or a vibe — and find the episodes to rewatch. Five years of noir, apocalypse and one vampire trying to earn a soul back.
regularsNote: The series regulars — Angel, Cordelia, Doyle, Wesley, Gunn, Fred/Illyria, Lorne, Connor and Spike — mostly aren't listed per-episode; use the Angel Investigations rows on the chart for them. Everyone else is here: Lilah, Lindsey, Darla, Drusilla, Kate Lockley, Holtz, Justine, Sahjhan, Jasmine, Harmony, Eve, Marcus Hamilton, Groo, Skip, and about 660 more.
chartHint: Click any bar to filter episodes by that era. Click a season number to filter by season. Shift-click to combine.
